_comment: Owned by Next.js — `next build` rewrites this file (it forces noEmit: true),
which is why apps/web is NOT a composite project in the root `tsc -b` graph.
It is still typechecked by TS 7.0.2 via the root `typecheck` script.
The AD-1 direction still holds here: web depends on contracts only.
_exclude_comment: Test files are excluded for the same reason apps/api excludes them: they are
not part of the shipped app, and leaving them in means `next build` compiles
them and `pnpm typecheck` resolves their imports. `vitest` is a devDependency
used by nothing the browser ever loads, so the app's build graph must not
